title: $3.95M Bridgehampton estate with 15th-century Buddhist temple replica listed for $7.5M
summary_full: A nearly 5-acre Bridgehampton estate featuring a replica 15th-century Buddhist temple has been listed for $7.5 million. Manhattan doctor and entrepreneur Roshini Raj bought the property for $3.95 million in 2022 and later made extensive changes. The estate includes a large main house, gardens, koi ponds, a pool, orchards and several leisure spaces.
